title: RECOMMENDATION_OUTCOME message (MBin to MTap, v1, draft)
description: What happened to a RECOMMENDATION or EXIT_RECOMMENDATION in MBin: one message per state change, closing with realized P&L. MTap's feedback loop. Stream mbin:evt:RECOMMENDATION_OUTCOME, durable. See mtap-mbin-protocol.md section 8.5.

_key.description: out:<subject.kind>:<subject.id>:<outcome>, plus :<seq> for outcomes that can repeat (filled on partial fills).

kind.description: rec: a RECOMMENDATION (id = rec_id). exit: an EXIT_RECOMMENDATION (id = exit_id).

outcome.description: See the outcome table in protocol section 8.5.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, e.g. stale_on_arrival, ttl, replaced, operator_ignore, sell_not_held, gate:budget, broker:<code>.

price.description: Average fill price in dollars (filled, closed).

realized_pnl_cents.description: closed only. Net of fees, integer cents.

account_alias.description: Account by role (D17). Account numbers and accountIdKey never cross the boundary.
